newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks slip ahead of U.S. holiday.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks slip ahead of U.S. holiday.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed lower on Wednesday in line with expectations of a relaxing trend ahead of a U.S. holiday on Thursday and after gains earlier in the week.

Two bids by electricity firm Endesa for 75 percent of the capital of Fecsa and Sevillana hit those stocks and added to the downward trend. Other big stocks remained solid and dealers said the market would remain fundamentally sound in the short term.
The general index fell 2.53 points, 0.63 percent, to 395.96 and the Ibex-35 lost 30.66 points, 0.67 percent, to 4,566.54.

"The bourse is confirming the latest expectations. After the recent highs and due to the holiday on Wall Street, no one wants to risk too much and one has to expect two days of consolidation," one dealer said.
Telefonica fell 40 pesetas to 2,840, accounting for a quarter of the total trading volume of some 44 billion pesetas.
Repsol showed some strength, gaining 45 pesetas, 0.98 percent, to 4,615 with just under one million shares traded.
